positions.title: Advisory Client Engineer - Cloud Infrastructure/Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Python (Programming Language) · Tekton CI/CD · Interpersonal Skills · OpenShift · watsonx ai · Generative AI

positions.title: Client Engineer - Cloud Infrastructure/Engineer
positions.locationName: Durham, North Carolina, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Optimized cloud deployment for ISV and GSI partner applications by updating traditional application APIs, implementing microservices, developing testing strategies, and interfacing with cloud provider data, events, and devops services.
- Worked collaboratively with ISV and GSI partner developers as they moved their technologies and offerings to IBM Cloud.
- Provided consultation and guidance to ISV and GSI partners as they integrated their products, services and offerings to IBM Cloud.
- Interfaced with marketing, expert services, development, other IBM/GSI delivery organizations, and business development leaders to ensure successful outcomes.
- Collaborated with leaders on projects in the Cloud Native Compute Foundation, LF AI Foundation, Node.js, and other open-source communities.
- Played a critical role in the expansion of partner ecosystem for IBM Cloud, collaborating with members of the business unit and other IBM teams.
- Contributed to the growth of IBM and external partners' cloud presence.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description: Work with a team to design, implement, and support full stack web applications for Appalachian State University in addition to the open source community.

positions.title: Watson and Cloud Services Developer
positions.description: Work as a team leader and member to redesign Virtual Computing Lab (VCL), which is a system that allows administrators to create and deploy images to a classroom, by using the MEAN stack. In addition to the redesign, we implemented new solutions for VCL to integrate Watson Services for classroom use around the world.
